g.text: A builds CSV import in worktree A.
B starts in worktree B of the same clone.
A is live in worktree A.
B retries until release or timeout.
Claims declare intent; they do not lock files.
Numbered claims can gate commit subjects.
Locks cover only the wrapped operation.
